source_message:
feat(scripts): Sprint 6 production deploy + verification scripts

- deploy-sprint6.sh: 8-step deployment to GMKtec
  1. git pull --rebase
  2. rsync compliance source via SSH
  3. Redis blocked jurisdictions sync
  4. PostgreSQL decision_events verification
  5. Emergency stop endpoint check
  6. FastAPI service restart
  7. Pre-tx gate + JIT credentials smoke tests
  8. Compliance snapshot ZIP to /tmp/audit-YYYY-MM-DD.zip
- verify-production.sh: 14 post-deploy checks across 5 categories
  (core services / infra / compliance stack / AI stack / security / audit)
  exits 0 if all critical checks pass, 1 otherwise

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
